user_reported_bug: The streaming fix wasn't enough to stay under the 512Mi memory limit. Please implement an image processing step that automatically resizes all uploaded photos to a maximum width of 1200px and converts them to a compressed format like WebP. Ensure this processing happens in small chunks to keep memory usage at a minimum, and serve these smaller versions on the photo page.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused Iter 160 preview verification passed: single 4.38 MB JPEG upload returned downscaled=true, image/webp, .webp storage, 36.6 KB size (99.16% reduction) and served width 1200; bulk upload of 3 JPEGs returned 3/3 downscaled WebP rows; seeded one 4.38 MB legacy JPEG and admin backfill processed it, saved 4.14 MB, and returned the required well-formed JSON. Backfill auth gates returned 401 unauthenticated and 403 for member. Commitment Ceremony 2026 album download returned HTTP 200 valid zip, 711,892 bytes (0.1358% of 500 MB guardrail). GET /api/auth/me and /api/photos/albums returned 200 after each backend operation, and /photos album grid + PhotoSwipe rendered the new WebP-backed photos with no UI error text. No mocked APIs used.

minor.issue: Code review note: processing is batched one-file-at-a-time with gc.collect(), but each file/object is still read into memory as bytes before Pillow processing (await file.read(), get_object()). No failures were observed with 4.38 MB test JPEGs; if the user means literal streaming/chunked file reads for 30 MB originals, add memory profiling or further hardening.

action_items: Optional hardening: if literal chunked/streamed reads are required, replace full await file.read()/get_object byte buffering with temp-file or streaming object-store processing and profile RSS under the 512 Mi production limit.
critical_code_review_comments: The implemented fix stores smaller WebP files and processes bulk/backfill sequentially, but it is not a true streaming/chunked image pipeline per individual file; runtime tests did not reproduce memory failures at the requested 3-5 MB size.

rca_of_the_issue: Original storage files were large JPEGs, so even streaming ZIP could still touch multi-MB originals. Verified fix stores new uploads/backfilled legacy rows as max-1200px WebP files and serves those smaller files on the photo page and zip path.
